translation: <ins>Bālí Powder (八釐散)</ins> Treats injuries from falls and blows, joins bones and disperses stagnant blood. Sappan wood powder (蘇木面, one qian), half-liang coin (半兩錢, one qian), pyrite (自然銅, quenched in vinegar seven times, three qian), frankincense (乳香, three qian), myrrh (沒藥, three qian), dragon's blood (血竭, three qian), musk (麝香, one fen), clove (丁香, five fen), nux vomica (番木鱉, fried in oil and dehaired, one qian). Grind all together into a fine powder, take warm with yellow wine; it may also be mixed with boy's urine (童便). <ins>Zheng Gu Zi Jin Dan (正骨紫金丹)</ins> Treats injuries from falls, blows, and sprains, and all pain with congealed stagnant blood.
